# clud

> clud is a fast Rust CLI, shipped as a Python wheel, that launches agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) in YOLO mode with model routing (Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter), an always-on session daemon, safety hooks, and a stdio MCP server for other agents. Unknown flags pass through to the harness.

Start with the CLI grammar: it is generated from clud's argument parser and is the single reference for every command and flag. Repository: https://github.com/talos-hq/clud. Remote assistance runs at https://clud.bot (its own index: https://clud.bot/llms.txt).

## Docs

- [CLI grammar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/cli-grammar.md): every command, subcommand, flag and positional; EBNF; passthrough and `--` rules; multicall names; environment; exit codes
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/README.md): install, usage examples, Hermes/MCP setup, command guard, `clud do` / `grind` / `loop`
- [Architecture index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): one doc per subsystem
- [Design decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/DESIGN_DECISIONS.md): why the non-obvious choices were made (DD-NNN)

## Launching

- [Launch plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/launch-plan.md): the one resolved argv; `--dry-run` JSON
- [Provider selection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/provider-selection.md): provider/harness flags, model IDs, effort and context
- [Launch targets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/launch-targets.md): sticky provider and harness preferences
- [Unsafe mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/unsafe-mode.md): what `--safe` and `--unsafe` change

## MCP and sessions

- [MCP server tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/src/clud/mcp_server.py): `python -m clud.mcp_server` (stdio). Tools: `run`, `run_json`, `dry_run`; `session_start`, `session_status`, `session_result`, `session_wait`, `session_wait_any`, `session_kill`, `session_inject`; `board_whoami`, `board_post`, `board_read`; `serve_start`, `serve_status`, `serve_stop`
- [Agent board](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/agent-board.md): the `board_*` bulletin board between agents
- [Session inject](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/session-inject.md): steering a running session (`session_inject`, `clud inject`)
- [API session storage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/api-session-storage.md): durable `/v1/sessions` behind `session_*`
- [Local API gateway](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/standalone-gateway.md): `clud serve` and `serve_*`
- [Daemon IPC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/daemon-ipc.md): `attach`, `list`, `kill`, `logs` and the always-on daemon
- [Remote assistance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talos-hq/clud/main/docs/architecture/remote-assistance.md): `clud remote connect` and clud.bot
